output.reason: [ev-57fea1f2c18e] says only that the metric `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_count` was renamed to `doublewrite_kvstore_only_identities`. Nothing says a workload, upgrade or resource fails, so behavior-change (review) at medium severity is the right kind. The proposed statement goes further than the evidence: it asserts that dashboards "will no longer receive data" and "must be updated". It also leaves out that the same section gives a second new name for the same old metric, `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_total` [ev-a2a020af7830]. The corrected statement sticks to what the evidence says and names both targets.

correction.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the metric doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_count is renamed to doublewrite_kvstore_only_identities. Monitoring queries, dashboards and alerts that use the old name should be reviewed and switched to the new name.

consequence.statement: The upgrade notes list the metric doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_count as renamed to doublewrite_kvstore_only_identities. Consumers that query the old name should be checked. The same section also lists a rename of this metric to doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_total, so confirm which name is actually exposed.
consequence.remediation: Update Prometheus queries, dashboards and alert rules that reference doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_count to use the metric name exposed after the upgrade (listed as doublewrite_kvstore_only_identities).
